about: Greenply Industries Ltd is an interior-infrastructure company with products spanning plywood and blockboards, MDF and pre-laminated MDF, decorative veneers, flush and PVC/WPC doors, specialty plywood, HDF flooring and furniture fittings. The group sells predominantly in India through a pan-India trade network. [1] [2]
